name: devops-fomo
description: Real-time intelligence on trending GitHub repos, viral AI agent tools, and DevOps projects. Multi-signal velocity scoring using stars, PRs, Hacker News, Reddit, and Dev.to data.

tools.name: get_trending_repos
tools.description: Get trending GitHub repositories sorted by multi-signal velocity score. Returns repos with stars, velocity badges (VIRAL BREAKOUT, HOT RISING, EARLY GEM), social signals from Hacker News and Dev.to, and growth metrics.

category.description: Filter by category. 'trending' returns all categories sorted by velocity.

sortBy.description: Sort order. 'velocity' uses composite multi-signal scoring.

search.description: Full-text search across repo names, descriptions, and topics.

tools.name: get_community_buzz
tools.description: Get aggregated tech news and discussions from Hacker News, Reddit, and Dev.to about trending developer tools and AI projects.
